StakeWiseV3ExitQueueAssisted.$comment: StakeWise V3 exit-queue assisted adapter on Gnosis (ADR 0015/0018/0030), GNO-denominated. Caches (vault, positionTicket, timestamp) tuples only, never amounts; values each live via calculateExitedAssets. Fed by the owner Safe through StakeWiseV3ExitQueueAssistant (msg.sender-keyed) and by a SUBMITTER_ROLE keeper (submitFor) for positions not opened through the assistant. 04 passes the chain's securityCouncil as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; no submitter is granted at deploy.
